text: Tucked away in Bostons iconic North End, 19 1/2 Tileston St sits beside the picturesque Prado, also known as Paul Revere Mall, offering a front-row seat to Italian culture, history, and the city's best dining. Inside, you'll find three generously sized bedrooms with ample closet space and natural light, making the home feel both spacious and inviting. Large windows frame rare unobstructed views of the Prado, creating a serene and unique city backdrop seldom found in the North End. This home comes with existing charm and value and also offers exciting potential to personalize or expand. Whether you're seeking a stylish city retreat or a smart long-term investment, 19 1/2 Tileston delivers the space, setting, and lifestyle that define the best of Boston living.
